1220:     end

1337: Battle::AI::Handlers::MoveEffectAgainstTargetScore.add("EnsureNextMoveAlwaysHits",
1338:   proc { |score, move, user, target, ai, battle|
1339:     next Battle::AI::MOVE_USELESS_SCORE if user.has_active_ability?(:NOGUARD) || target.has_active_ability?(:NOGUARD)
1340:     next Battle::AI::MOVE_USELESS_SCORE if target.effects[PBEffects::Telekinesis] > 0
1341:     # Prefer if the user knows moves with low accuracy
1342:     user.battler.eachMove do |m|
1343:       next if target.effects[PBEffects::Minimize] && m.tramplesMinimize? && Settings::MECHANICS_GENERATION >= 6
1344:       acc = m.accuracy
1345:       acc = m.pbBaseAccuracy(user.battler, target.battler) if ai.trainer.medium_skill?
1346:       score += 5 if acc < 90 && acc != 0
1347:       score += 8 if acc <= 50 && acc != 0
1348:       score += 8 if m.is_a?(Battle::Move::OHKO)
1349:     end
1350:     # Prefer if the target has increased evasion
1351:     score += 5 * target.stages[:EVASION] if target.stages[:EVASION] > 0
1352:     # Not worth it if the user or the target is at low HP
1353:     if ai.trainer.has_skill_flag?("HPAware")
1354:       score -= 10 if user.hp < user.totalhp / 2
1355:       score -= 8 if target.hp < target.totalhp / 2
1356:     end
1357:     next score
1358:   }

1487: Battle::AI::Handlers::MoveEffectAgainstTargetScore.add("TargetMovesBecomeElectric",
1488:   proc { |score, move, user, target, ai, battle|
1489:     # Get Electric's effectiveness against the user
1490:     electric_eff = user.effectiveness_of_type_against_battler(:ELECTRIC, target)
1491:     electric_eff *= 1.5 if target.has_type?(:ELECTRIC)   # STAB
1492:     electric_eff = 0 if user.has_active_ability?([:LIGHTNINGROD, :MOTORDRIVE, :VOLTABSORB])
1493:     # For each of target's moves, get its effectiveness against the user and
1494:     # decide whether it is better or worse than Electric's effectiveness
1495:     old_type_better = 0
1496:     electric_type_better = 0
1497:     target.battler.eachMove do |m|
1498:       next if !m.damagingMove?
1499:       m_type = m.pbCalcType(target.battler)
1500:       next if m_type == :ELECTRIC
1501:       eff = user.effectiveness_of_type_against_battler(m_type, target, m)
1502:       eff *= 1.5 if target.has_type?(m_type)   # STAB
1503:       case m_type
1504:       when :FIRE
1505:         eff = 0 if user.has_active_ability?(:FLASHFIRE)
1506:       when :GRASS
1507:         eff = 0 if user.has_active_ability?(:SAPSIPPER)
1508:       when :WATER
1509:         eff = 0 if user.has_active_ability?([:STORMDRAIN, :WATERABSORB])
1510:       end
1511:       if eff > electric_eff
1512:         electric_type_better += 1
1513:       elsif eff < electric_eff
1514:         old_type_better += 1
1515:       end
1516:     end
1517:     next Battle::AI::MOVE_USELESS_SCORE if electric_type_better == 0
1518:     next Battle::AI::MOVE_USELESS_SCORE if electric_type_better < old_type_better
1519:     score += 10 * (electric_type_better - old_type_better)
1520:     next score
1521:   }
1522: )

1527: Battle::AI::Handlers::MoveEffectScore.add("NormalMovesBecomeElectric",
1528:   proc { |score, move, user, ai, battle|
1529:     base_electric_eff = Effectiveness::NORMAL_EFFECTIVE_MULTIPLIER
1530:     base_electric_eff = 0 if user.has_active_ability?([:LIGHTNINGROD, :MOTORDRIVE, :VOLTABSORB])
1531:     # Check all affected foe battlers for Normal moves, get their effectiveness
1532:     # against the user and decide whether it is better or worse than Electric's
1533:     # effectiveness
1534:     normal_type_better = 0
1535:     electric_type_better = 0
1536:     ai.each_foe_battler(user.side) do |b, i|
1537:       next if move.rough_priority(b) <= 0 && b.faster_than?(user)
1538:       next if !b.has_damaging_move_of_type?(:NORMAL)
1539:       # Normal's effectiveness
1540:       eff = user.effectiveness_of_type_against_battler(:NORMAL, b)
1541:       eff *= 1.5 if b.has_type?(:NORMAL)   # STAB
1542:       # Electric's effectiveness
1543:       elec_eff = user.effectiveness_of_type_against_battler(:ELECTRIC, b)
1544:       elec_eff *= 1.5 if b.has_type?(:ELECTRIC)   # STAB
1545:       elec_eff *= base_electric_eff
1546:       # Compare the two
1547:       if eff > elec_eff
1548:         electric_type_better += 1
1549:       elsif eff < elec_eff
1550:         normal_type_better += 1
1551:       end
1552:     end
1553:     if electric_type_better == 0 || electric_type_better < normal_type_better
1554:       next (move.statusMove?) ? Battle::AI::MOVE_USELESS_SCORE : score
1555:     end
1556:     score += 10 * (electric_type_better - normal_type_better)
1557:     next score
1558:   }
1559: )
